53b3f6d6d4.q: How did Chase Hazelwood grow Go Forth Pest Control from $2.5 million to $52 million in revenue?
53b3f6d6d4.a: Hazelwood transitioned from working in the business to working on it by implementing modern technology, automation, and online systems in 2018. He created checklists and processes for every customer interaction, implemented a 24-hour service guarantee, and developed a mobile device management system allowing technicians to operate remotely. He also adopted a sales philosophy where service is sales and trained all employees in consultative customer interaction, rather than recruiting dedicated salespeople.
